title: Vegan Indian Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired curry made with a variety of spices and herbs. This dish is perfect for a vegan dinner option.

ingredients.name: parma ham
ingredients.amount: 2 tablespoons, (replaced with vegan alternative, e.g., tofu or tempeh)

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato, coconut milk, chickpeas, and basil. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
